retrievalProfile.description: A four-quadrant grid layout featuring distinct photographic panels enclosed within a double-line border on a dark background with bold sans-serif headers.
triggerTerms: framed photo collage with header and footer text

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 2x2 grid of rectangular images, each individually framed with a thin red border, all contained within a larger white-outlined square on a solid black field. Bold, wide-set sans-serif typography anchors the top and bottom of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Double-stroke white border containing the grid
High-contrast white text against a black background
Individual red framing for each internal image
coreInvariants: Thin red inner borders for each quadrant

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four equal-sized rectangular images arranged in a central square grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The top display text serves as the primary entry point, followed by the grid.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Z-pattern starting from the top header, through the four quadrants, ending at the footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black margins surrounding the central framed grid.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: White for primary borders and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red for thin internal image borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black field; varied saturation within the internal photos.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with varying weights and tracking for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Thin red rectangular frames for sub-images

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric construction and sharp terminals.
Provides the necessary width and modern clean aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background. In the center, place a 2x2 grid of four distinct rectangular photographs. Each photograph should have a thin red border. Surround the entire 2x2 grid with a thin white double-line square frame, leaving ample black space at the top and bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in white. Place the primary title at the top center with wide tracking. Place the secondary title at the bottom center with extra-wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Are there four distinct images in a 2x2 grid?
Does each image have a red border?
Is the text white, uppercase, and wide-tracked?

mustRedesign: Artist names or specific album titles

mustAchieve: Consistent stroke weight for the white outer frame
High-contrast legibility of the white text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white frame is perfectly square.
Check that the red borders do not overlap.
Verify the text is centered horizontally.
Confirm the black background is uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid-based anthology layout with high-contrast geometric typography and multi-layered framing.
